name: Sakai Ei
source:
A was B's classmate in high school and came back after suddenly disappearing for half a year. She's a mischievous troublemaker that loves pranks, cryptids, and anything dangerous. A has no filter for her actions, often disturbing other people without caring about the consequences.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamrobo/tomorrow-will-be-dying-a-university-life-sim-visual-novel?ref=creator_nav]Kickstarter[/url]]
